persons.name: Machiṃdra
persons.evidence: majasyanitolayā. machiṃdrana ... thamana soyayāta. pe guliṃ saphūlidayakā julo

notes: The sponsor Machiṃdra of Majasyanitola had the four sections (mitralābha, suhṛdbheda, vigraha, saṃdhi) made into books for his own study (thamana soyayāta pe guliṃ saphūlidayakā julo).
